title: Stability of a simple root under coefficient perturbation over a henselian valued field
statement: Let $F$ be a field with a nontrivial valuation and henselian valuation ring [def-trf-valuation-ring, def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology]. Its valuation topology has balls $v(x-a)>\gamma$ as a basis, for the additive valuation into a totally ordered abelian group. Let $f(T)=T^n+\sum_{i<n}c_iT^i\in F[T]$ be monic of degree $n\geq1$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. Suppose $a\in F$ is a simple root: $f(a)=0$ and $f^{\prime}(a)\ne0$, where $f^{\prime}$ is the formal derivative. For every open neighbourhood $U$ of $a$ there is an open neighbourhood $V$ of $(c_0,\ldots,c_{n-1})$ in the product topology on $F^n$ such that, for every $(d_0,\ldots,d_{n-1})\in V$, the polynomial $g(T)=T^n+\sum_{i<n}d_iT^i$ has a simple root $b\in U$. The valuation may have arbitrary rank; completeness is not assumed.
